### `framing_scenario`

| `total_value_wei` | `numeric(38,0)` | NO |  |  |  |
| `created_at` | `timestamp` | NO |  | `now()` |  |

### `flag`

One detector-raised signal that the audit engine interrogates for frameability. (migration 002) System-versioned (migration 009): trigger flag_versioning (AFTER UPDATE OR DELETE) writes every before-image into flag_history; flag_as_of(ts) and flag_versions(id) read it back.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `flag_id` | `bigint` | NO | PK | auto |  |
| `run_id` | `bigint` | NO | FK → `analysis_run.run_id` |  | Index idx_flag_run |
| `wallet_id` | `bigint` | NO | FK → `wallet.wallet_id` |  | Index idx_flag_wallet |
| `detector` | `varchar(30)` | NO |  |  | bfs_proximity / sybil_cluster / pagerank_threshold / impurity / engaged_proximity |
| `score` | `double` | YES |  |  |  |
| `threshold` | `double` | YES |  |  |  |
| `created_at` | `timestamp` | NO |  | `now()` |  |
| `token_contract` | `char(42)` | YES |  |  | Migration 005: the ERC-20 contract that crossed the threshold; NULL for native ETH |

### `flag_audit`

One audit verdict: could an outsider have manufactured this flag, and at what cost. (migration 002) Append-only and hash-chained (migration 009): trigger flag_audit_chain (BEFORE INSERT) links each row to the last; trigger flag_audit_append_only refuses UPDATE, and refuses DELETE unless framecheck.allow_audit_delete = on, tombstoning it. flag_audit_chain_verify() names the first row that does not fit.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `flag_audit_id` | `bigint` | NO | PK | auto |  |
| `flag_id` | `bigint` | NO | FK → `flag.flag_id` |  | Not unique: a flag can be re-audited; the API reports the latest. Index idx_flag_audit_flag |
| `verdict` | `varchar(12)` | NO |  |  | CHECK (verdict IN ('frameable', 'robust')) |
| `framing_cost_wei` | `numeric(38,0)` | YES |  |  | CHECK flag_audit_cost_nonneg (NULL or >= 0), migration 007 |
| `framing_gas` | `bigint` | YES |  |  | CHECK flag_audit_gas_nonneg (NULL or >= 0), migration 007 |
| `minimal_tx_set` | `jsonb` | YES |  |  |  |
| `method` | `varchar(20)` | NO |  |  | CHECK (method IN ('exact', 'greedy_upper_bound', 'yes_no')); greedy is an upper bound, only exact is a true minimum |
| `backend` | `varchar(40)` | YES |  |  |  |
| `runtime_ms` | `int` | YES |  |  |  |
| `created_at` | `timestamp` | NO |  | `now()` |  |
| `prev_hash` | `bytea` | YES |  |  | Migration 009: row_hash of the preceding audit row (genesis links to a fixed seed). Set by trigger, never by the app |
| `row_hash` | `bytea` | YES |  |  | Migration 009: sha256(prev_hash \|\| flag_audit_payload(row)). Set by trigger, never by the app |

### `flag_history`

Before-images of every changed or deleted flag, with the period each version was valid for. Written only by trigger flag_versioning. (migration 009) No FK by design: history must outlive the flag it describes -- scripts/run_experiment.py deletes flags wholesale, and a FK would block that or cascade the history away. Non-overlap: EXCLUDE USING gist (flag_id WITH =, sys_period WITH &&) as flag_history_no_overlap when btree_gist is available, else a unique index on (flag_id, lower(sys_period)).

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `flag_history_id` | `bigint` | NO | PK | auto |  |
| `flag_id` | `bigint` | NO |  |  | Deliberately NOT a foreign key: history must outlive the flag row it describes |
| `change_op` | `char(1)` | NO |  |  | CHECK (change_op IN ('U', 'D')) |
| `changed_by` | `text` | NO |  |  |  |
| `before_image` | `jsonb` | NO |  |  | to_jsonb(OLD): generic, so later columns are captured without changing this table |
| `sys_period` | `tstzrange` | NO |  |  | CHECK (NOT isempty(sys_period)); [became current, stopped being) |

### `flag_audit_tombstone`

Every audit row ever deleted, who deleted it and why. A chain gap with no tombstone is tampering; a gap with one is housekeeping. Written only by trigger flag_audit_append_only. (migration 009) No FK by design: it names flag_audit rows that have been deleted, so there is nothing left to reference.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tombstone_id` | `bigint` | NO | PK | auto |  |
| `flag_audit_id` | `bigint` | NO |  |  | Logical reference to the deleted flag_audit row -- no FK, because that row is gone. Index idx_flag_audit_tombstone_audit |
| `flag_id` | `bigint` | NO |  |  |  |
| `verdict` | `varchar(12)` | YES |  |  |  |
| `row_hash` | `bytea` | YES |  |  | What the chain expected to find at this position |
| `deleted_by` | `text` | NO |  |  |  |
| `deleted_at` | `timestamptz` | NO |  | `now()` |  |
| `reason` | `text` | NO |  |  |  |

## App and ops

### `app_user`

The single Users table: everyone who can sign in (Google or a local bcrypt password), with a role -- admin, analyst or viewer -- that drives authorisation. (migration 006; roles and local accounts, migration 010) Migration 010 folded the old `analyst` table into it: the `system` service account is an inactive admin that owns pipeline runs, and analysis_run.analyst_id, wallet_label.tagged_by and alert.reviewed_by now reference it.

| Column | Type | Null | Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_id` | `bigint` | NO | PK | auto |  |
| `google_sub` | `text` | YES | UNIQUE |  | Google subject id: stable, unlike the email address. NULL for local-only accounts (nullable since migration 010) |
| `email` | `text` | NO |  |  | Index idx_app_user_email |
| `display_name` | `text` | YES |  |  |  |
| `picture_url` | `text` | YES |  |  |  |
| `created_at` | `timestamptz` | NO |  | `now()` |  |
| `last_login_at` | `timestamptz` | YES |  |  |  |
| `role` | `varchar(20)` | NO |  | `viewer` | Migration 010. CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'analyst', 'viewer')); read on every request, never trusted from the session token |
| `username` | `varchar(40)` | YES | UNIQUE |  | Migration 010. Local sign-in name |
| `password_hash` | `varchar(255)` | YES |  |  | Migration 010. bcrypt (cost 12) for local accounts; never returned by the API |
| `organisation` | `varchar(80)` | YES |  |  | Migration 010 |
| `is_active` | `boolean` | NO |  | `true` | Migration 010. CHECK app_user_can_sign_in (google_sub IS NOT NULL OR password_hash IS NOT NULL OR NOT is_active) |
